title: Square Crop
about: Crop an image to a centered 1:1 square. Adjust the crop frame and export the selected square region.
steps: Choose a JPG, PNG, or WebP image up to 20 MB, or drag it into the upload area.
Review the original preview and adjust the controls available for this tool.
Run the operation and wait for the browser to finish processing.
Compare the result with the original and inspect edges or details.
Download the processed image when the preview looks correct.
capabilities: Canvas crop coordinates enforce equal output width and height.
benefits: This browser workspace keeps the operation, preview, and export controls together. The original source file is not overwritten; inspect the output before using it elsewhere.
limitations: Cropping removes pixels outside the selected square. Keep a copy of the original.

faqs.question: What does Square Crop do?
faqs.answer: Crop an image to a centered 1:1 square. Adjust the crop frame and export the selected square region.

faqs.question: Are my images uploaded?
faqs.answer: Image editing and export run in your browser. The background-removal model may need to download model assets the first time it runs.

faqs.question: Which formats can I export?
faqs.answer: Choose an available PNG, JPEG, or WebP output format. Transparency is preserved only by PNG or WebP.

faqs.question: Will every image produce perfect edges?
faqs.answer: No. Results depend on image quality, contrast, subject complexity, and browser memory. Review the preview before downloading.
